en: Color New Year postcard. Front shows a lit candle and a large red ornament with snowflakes on a blue background and a round photo inset of children in Romanian winter folk costumes celebrating in the snow. The text at top reads "La mulți ani!". The back is a Romanian postcard with preprinted green 'România Poșta Română 40 bani' indicium, Romanian address lines, cancellation marks, a handwritten holiday message, and address to Câmpina, Prahova.
